issues.problem: Distractor の gives 母からの野菜をもらいました, a natural sentence with the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor の with へ (からへ is ungrammatical).

issues.problem: 昼に is a marked way to say 'during the day'; natural speech says 昼(間)は without に, so the に-time model is doubtful.
issues.action: Rewrote as 週末には家にいますが、平日にはいません ('at weekends ... weekdays'), lv 3.
